_readme: Package metadata for the GUI. name = short label, desc = what it is, risk = low|medium|high|critical. Key: Android package id.

com.android.chrome.name: Chrome
com.android.chrome.desc: Google browser. Some apps use it for in-app web pages (Custom Tabs).

com.android.contacts.name: Contacts
com.android.contacts.desc: Contacts app. On Xiaomi this package is MIUI Contacts.

com.android.incallui.name: In-call screen
com.android.incallui.desc: The screen shown during phone calls.

com.android.location.fused.name: Fused location
com.android.location.fused.desc: Combines GPS, Wi-Fi and cell data for location.

com.android.mms.name: Messages
com.android.mms.desc: SMS/MMS app. On Xiaomi this is MIUI Messages.

com.android.providers.telephony.name: Telephony storage
com.android.providers.telephony.desc: Database provider for SMS and APN data.

com.android.server.telecom.name: Telecom service
com.android.server.telecom.desc: Routes calls between apps and the modem.

com.android.systemui.name: System UI
com.android.systemui.desc: Status bar, quick settings, notifications and navigation.

com.google.android.gms.name: Google Play services
com.google.android.gms.desc: Core Google APIs used by most apps.

com.google.android.gsf.name: Google Services Framework
com.google.android.gsf.desc: Account and service plumbing for Google apps.

com.google.android.packageinstaller.name: Google package installer
com.google.android.packageinstaller.desc: Installs APKs on newer Android versions.

com.google.android.webview.name: Android System WebView
com.google.android.webview.desc: Renders web content inside other apps.

com.miui.home.name: MIUI Launcher
com.miui.home.desc: The home screen and app drawer.

com.miui.securitycenter.name: MIUI Security
com.miui.securitycenter.desc: App lock, permissions, cleaner, battery and blocklist.

com.miui.securityadd.name: MIUI Security add-on
com.miui.securityadd.desc: Part of the Security app. Removing it can bootloop older MIUI.

com.miui.powerkeeper.name: MIUI Power Keeper
com.miui.powerkeeper.desc: Aggressive MIUI battery and performance manager.

com.miui.daemon.name: MIUI Daemon
com.miui.daemon.desc: Background daemon used by several MIUI features.

com.miui.contentcatcher.name: Content Catcher
com.miui.contentcatcher.desc: Text and image recognition when long-pressing on screen.

com.miui.miwallpaper.name: Mi Wallpaper
com.miui.miwallpaper.desc: System wallpaper provider. Removing breaks wallpaper setting.

com.miui.analytics.name: MIUI Analytics
com.miui.analytics.desc: Sends usage and diagnostic data to Xiaomi.

com.miui.msa.global.name: MSA
com.miui.msa.global.desc: Xiaomi advertising and analytics framework used by system apps.

com.miui.systemAdSolution.name: System Ad Solution
com.miui.systemAdSolution.desc: Serves ads inside MIUI system apps.

com.miui.bugreport.name: MIUI Bug Report
com.miui.bugreport.desc: Captures logs and sends feedback to Xiaomi.

com.miui.miservice.name: Services & Feedback
com.miui.miservice.desc: Xiaomi support, feedback and service app.

com.miui.cleanmaster.name: Clean Master
com.miui.cleanmaster.desc: Older Xiaomi cleaner package with Cheetah Mobile heritage.

com.miui.klo.bugreport.name: KLO Bug Report
com.miui.klo.bugreport.desc: Collects app and system crashes and uploads them to Xiaomi.

com.miui.misightservice.name: MiSight
com.miui.misightservice.desc: Telemetry and diagnostics collector that reports to Xiaomi.

com.miui.spock.name: Spock
com.miui.spock.desc: Hidden analytics package that sends device details to Xiaomi.

com.miui.wmsvc.name: WMService
com.miui.wmsvc.desc: Background service with analytics and advertising ID access.

com.miui.cit.name: CIT
com.miui.cit.desc: Hidden hardware test menu used by service centres.

com.miui.tv.analytics.name: TV Analytics
com.miui.tv.analytics.desc: Analytics component for Xiaomi TV features.

com.miui.uireporter.name: UI Reporter
com.miui.uireporter.desc: Hidden MIUI diagnostics and reporting component.

com.miui.voicetrigger.name: Voice Trigger
com.miui.voicetrigger.desc: Wake-word detection for the voice assistant.

com.miui.videoplayer.name: Mi Video
com.miui.videoplayer.desc: Xiaomi video player with ads and recommendations.

com.miui.video.name: Mi Video (legacy)
com.miui.video.desc: Older package name for Mi Video.

com.miui.player.name: Mi Music
com.miui.player.desc: Xiaomi music player with online content and ads.

com.miui.fm.name: FM Radio
com.miui.fm.desc: FM radio app, needs wired headphones as antenna.

com.miui.fmservice.name: FM Radio Service
com.miui.fmservice.desc: Background service used by the FM radio app.

com.xiaomi.mipicks.name: GetApps
com.xiaomi.mipicks.desc: Xiaomi app store. Can take over install prompts.

com.mi.globalbrowser.name: Mi Browser
com.mi.globalbrowser.desc: Xiaomi browser with ads and telemetry.

com.xiaomi.android.tvsetup.partnercustom.name: Setup Customizer
com.xiaomi.android.tvsetup.partnercustom.desc: Installs partner apps during first-time setup.

com.miui.gallery.name: Mi Gallery
com.miui.gallery.desc: Xiaomi gallery. Removing breaks the 3-finger screenshot preview.

com.miui.personalassistant.name: App Vault
com.miui.personalassistant.desc: Left-most home screen panel with shortcuts and ads.

com.miui.cloudservice.name: Mi Cloud
com.miui.cloudservice.desc: Xiaomi cloud sync. Removing also disables Find Device and cloud backup.

com.miui.cloudbackup.name: Mi Cloud Backup
com.miui.cloudbackup.desc: Backs up contacts, messages and settings to Xiaomi cloud.

com.miui.backup.name: Local Backup
com.miui.backup.desc: MIUI local backup and restore tool.

com.xiaomi.joyose.name: Joyose
com.xiaomi.joyose.desc: Game and performance tuning service. Some Game Turbo features may stop working.

com.miui.antispam.name: MIUI Antispam
com.miui.antispam.desc: Spam call and SMS filtering. Removing loses this protection.

com.miui.extraphoto.name: Bokeh / Document mode
com.miui.extraphoto.desc: Extra camera modes such as document scanning.

com.miui.yellowpage.name: Yellow Pages
com.miui.yellowpage.desc: Caller and business directory data from Xiaomi partners.

com.miui.phrase.name: Frequent Phrases
com.miui.phrase.desc: Paste menu with saved phrases, linked to Mi Cloud.

com.miui.thirdappassistant.name: Third-party App Assistant
com.miui.thirdappassistant.desc: Helper for installing and managing third-party apps.

com.miui.vipservice.name: Mi VIP Service
com.miui.vipservice.desc: Xiaomi customer support and VIP services.

com.miui.contentextension.name: Taplus
com.miui.contentextension.desc: Long-press image and text analysis. Off by default.

com.miui.miwallpaper.earth.name: Super Wallpaper Earth
com.miui.miwallpaper.earth.desc: Animated Earth live wallpaper, several hundred MB.

com.miui.miwallpaper.mars.name: Super Wallpaper Mars
com.miui.miwallpaper.mars.desc: Animated Mars live wallpaper, several hundred MB.

com.xiaomi.mirecycle.name: Mi Recycle
com.xiaomi.mirecycle.desc: Device trade-in and recycling service inside Security app.

com.xiaomi.calendar.name: Mi Calendar
com.xiaomi.calendar.desc: Xiaomi calendar app with cloud sync.

com.xiaomi.mirror.name: MIUI+
com.xiaomi.mirror.desc: Mirrors the phone screen to a PC.

com.xiaomi.scanner.name: Mi Scanner
com.xiaomi.scanner.desc: Xiaomi document and QR scanner with many permissions.

com.facebook.appmanager.name: Facebook App Manager
com.facebook.appmanager.desc: Installs and updates Facebook apps in the background.

com.facebook.system.name: Facebook System
com.facebook.system.desc: Stub that installs the main Facebook app.

com.amazon.appmanager.name: Amazon App Manager
com.amazon.appmanager.desc: Updates Amazon apps in the background.

com.google.android.apps.wellbeing.name: Digital Wellbeing
com.google.android.apps.wellbeing.desc: Screen time tracking. Some Settings pages depend on it.

com.google.android.videos.name: Google TV
com.google.android.videos.desc: Google TV and Play Movies app.

com.google.android.apps.subscriptions.re.name: Google One
com.google.android.apps.subscriptions.re.desc: Google One subscription and storage app.

com.sec.android.app.launcher.name: Samsung One UI Home
com.sec.android.app.launcher.desc: The home screen and app drawer.

com.samsung.android.honeyboard.name: Samsung Keyboard
com.samsung.android.honeyboard.desc: Default keyboard. Keep another keyboard installed before touching this.

com.samsung.android.app.telephonyui.name: Samsung Telephony UI
com.samsung.android.app.telephonyui.desc: Phone settings and SIM manager. Disabling breaks them.

com.samsung.android.app.contacts.name: Samsung Contacts
com.samsung.android.app.contacts.desc: Contacts app used by the Samsung dialer.

com.samsung.android.MtpApplication.name: Samsung MTP
com.samsung.android.MtpApplication.desc: Lets the phone expose files over USB.

com.samsung.android.app.spage.name: Samsung Free
com.samsung.android.app.spage.desc: Left-most home screen news and ads panel.

com.samsung.android.visionintelligence.name: Vision Intelligence
com.samsung.android.visionintelligence.desc: Image recognition engine used by Bixby Vision and Gallery.

com.samsung.android.app.watchmanagerstub.name: Galaxy Wearable stub
com.samsung.android.app.watchmanagerstub.desc: Installs Galaxy Wearable for watches and buds.

com.samsung.android.smartswitchassistant.name: Smart Switch Agent
com.samsung.android.smartswitchassistant.desc: Background helper for Smart Switch transfers.

com.samsung.android.dqagent.name: Device Quality Agent
com.samsung.android.dqagent.desc: Diagnostics logger. Safe on most phones but may affect Samsung support logs.

com.samsung.android.app.omcagent.name: OMC Agent
com.samsung.android.app.omcagent.desc: Installs recommended partner apps after setup.

com.samsung.android.messaging.name: Samsung Messages
com.samsung.android.messaging.desc: Default SMS app. Install another SMS app first if you remove this.

com.samsung.android.app.appsedge.name: Apps Edge
com.samsung.android.app.appsedge.desc: Edge panel with favourite apps. May affect split-screen.

com.samsung.android.app.aodservice.name: Always On Display
com.samsung.android.app.aodservice.desc: AOD and lock-screen clock. Disabling also hides the lock-screen clock.

com.samsung.SMT.name: Samsung TTS
com.samsung.SMT.desc: Text-to-speech engine. Apps that read text aloud need it.

com.samsung.android.app.watchmanager.name: Galaxy Wearable
com.samsung.android.app.watchmanager.desc: Companion app for Galaxy watches and buds.

com.samsung.android.app.camera.sticker.f.name: Camera AR Stickers
com.samsung.android.app.camera.sticker.f.desc: Preloaded face stickers for the camera.

com.samsung.android.app.camera.sticker.f.name: Camera Avatar Stickers
com.samsung.android.app.camera.sticker.f.desc: Preloaded avatar stickers for the camera.

com.samsung.android.app.camera.sticker.s.name: Camera Stamp Stickers
com.samsung.android.app.camera.sticker.s.desc: Preloaded stamp stickers for the camera.

com.samsung.android.app.memo.name: Samsung Memo
com.samsung.android.app.memo.desc: Legacy memo app replaced by Samsung Notes.

com.samsung.android.app.simplesharing.name: Link Sharing
com.samsung.android.app.simplesharing.desc: Shares large files through Samsung Cloud links.

com.samsung.android.app.sketchbook.name: Keyboard Sketchbook
com.samsung.android.app.sketchbook.desc: AI drawing extension for Samsung Keyboard.

com.samsung.android.app.earphonetypec.name: USB-C Earphone Support
com.samsung.android.app.earphonetypec.desc: Firmware updates for Samsung USB-C earphones.

com.samsung.android.app.mirrorlink.name: MirrorLink
com.samsung.android.app.mirrorlink.desc: Connects the phone to compatible car head units.

com.samsung.android.allshare.service.med.name: AllShare / Smart View
com.samsung.android.allshare.service.med.desc: Streams media to Samsung TVs. Smart View may still work via Nearby Service.

com.samsung.android.beaconmanager.name: Beacon Manager
com.samsung.android.beaconmanager.desc: Nearby device scanning for Samsung accessories.

com.samsung.android.easysetup.name: Easy Setup
com.samsung.android.easysetup.desc: Nearby device setup for Samsung accessories.

com.samsung.android.coreapps.name: Enhanced Features
com.samsung.android.coreapps.desc: Samsung enhanced messaging and profile sharing.

com.samsung.android.da.daagent.name: Dual Messenger
com.samsung.android.da.daagent.desc: Runs two accounts of the same messaging app.

com.samsung.android.deviceidservice.name: Device ID Service
com.samsung.android.deviceidservice.desc: Provides advertising and device identifiers to Samsung services.

com.samsung.android.digitalkey.name: Digital Key
com.samsung.android.digitalkey.desc: Phone-as-a-key support for cars and doors.

com.samsung.android.ardrawing.name: AR Doodles
com.samsung.android.ardrawing.desc: Draw on faces and surroundings in AR Zone.

com.alightcreative.motion.name: Alight Motion
com.alightcreative.motion.desc: Motion graphics and video editing app.
